svg.text: run.c — Llama-2 inference in one C file
Under six hundred lines, no dependency but libm. Each box names the thing and then says what it actually does. Read the bands top to bottom: that is roughly the order the file itself is written in.
1 · BUILD AND RUN · one file, one compiler call, two input files
2 · THE THREE STRUCTS · Config sizes everything, TransformerWeights is the model, RunState is the scratch space
3 · LOADING THE CHECKPOINT · thirteen freads in a fixed order, with no header magic to check them against
4 · THE FOUR PRIMITIVES · the whole numerical vocabulary of the file
5 · ONE FORWARD PASS · transformer(token, pos, ...) · the top row and then the bottom row run once per layer, n_layers times
6 · THE GENERATION LOOP · one token per iteration, exactly seq_len of them
7 · MEMORY AND LIFETIME · allocate once before the loop, free once after it
8 · WHAT IT LEAVES OUT, ON PURPOSE · and what the omissions buy
R · SHAPES AND POINTER ARITHMETIC · what the comments claim
